commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+3' Celta Vigo are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
90+1' 3 - 2 It's a goal! Moi Gomez (Osasuna) scores. Unfortunately for him, it's an own goal!
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Substitution. Aimar Oroz leaves the pitch and is replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
88' Vicente Moreno decides to make a substitution. Jon Moncayola will be replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
87' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
86' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) is sent off! He receives a red card and the match ends for him. He attempts to argue, but the referee's decision is final.
86' Celta Vigo are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
82' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Osasuna have a corner.
80' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Iker Benito (Osasuna) replaces Ruben Garcia.
77' Here is a change. Ante Budimir is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
76' Ilaix Moriba will be replaced by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).

76' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the set piece, took a good first touch and unleashed a mid-range projectile to the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera makes a nice save.
76' Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
74' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) receives a yellow card.
73' A player from Celta Vigo commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
73' A long pass, executed by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
70' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) expertly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate at all and the ball goes high over the crossbar.
70' Celta Vigo win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
70' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) commits a rough foul. Juan Martinez Munuera stops the game and makes a call.
66' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
65' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is adjudged offside.
64' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) replacing Borja Iglesias.
63' Substitution. Bryan Zaragoza makes way for Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
62' 3 - 1 Goal! Abel Bretones (Osasuna) finds some space for a shot from the edge of the box and his attempt goes low inside the right post. Fantastic finish.

61' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Sergio Herrera shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
60' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar.
59' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Celta Vigo keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
57' A long pass, executed by Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
57' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
56' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
55' One of the players from Celta Vigo times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
54' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) is penalised for holding. Juan Martinez Munuera signals a set piece.
53' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
47' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Osasuna.
46' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' Substitution. Williot Swedberg makes his way off the pitch and Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) comes on as his replacement.
46' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Carlos Dominguez and he is replaced by Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo).
46' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fran Beltran.
46' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+4' Osasuna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 2 - 1 Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) gets on the scoresheet, but unfortunately for him it's an own goal.
44' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Osasuna was in an offside position.
42' The ball is cleared after Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.

39' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Martinez Munuera blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
38' Celta Vigo show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
35' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
33' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle. Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) commits a foul after dangerous play.

29' 1 - 1 What a goal! Oscar Mingueza plays it to Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Sergio Herrera into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
29' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
28' The Celta Vigo players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Osasuna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
24' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
21' The linesman makes the right call and Osasuna will have a corner.
19' PENALTY APPEAL by Osasuna, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
19' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
17' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Ivan Villar (Celta Vigo) leaps to collect the ball.
17' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) takes the ball and runs towards the goal. He skips past one defender and gets into an ideal shooting position, but his promising attempt ends inches wide of the right post.
15' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
13' A player from Osasuna commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

12' Unbelievable! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) wastes a huge scoring opportunity! He finds himself unmarked right in front of goal and fires in a first-time shot. Sergio Herrera pulls off one of the best saves of his career and stops the effort from hitting the net.
11' Osasuna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
7' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
6' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
4' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle and it's Jesus Areso (Osasuna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' Osasuna are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
2' The game is interrupted. Abel Bretones (Osasuna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Juan Martinez Munuera.
